questiontext.text: Which of the following are visible symptoms of insect pest damage on crop foliage? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Defoliation, skeletonization, and leaf curling are classic insect damage symptoms.

questiontext.text: Which of the following are major economic consequences of severe pest attacks on agriculture? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Pests reduce yields, collapse market value, and destroy stored food. They increase, rather than eliminate, labor costs.
